messages:
amal: Heads-up — POC kickoff with FinTechX starts next Monday. Need to lock success criteria, token/budget estimate, and GPU sizing. CTO also asked for a rough cost number.

sophie: Can you paste the target use cases and approx prompt lengths so we can scope evals? :mag:

amal: Use cases:
- customer support summarization (multi-turn transcripts, sometimes long)
- transaction anomaly assistant (shorter prompts, high QPS)
- semantic search via embeddings
Prompts vary: 300–800 tokens typical, occasional >2k for long transcripts.

matt: Quick capacity sketch for planning:
```
avg_tokens_per_req = 800
peak_rps = 4    # simultaneous interactive users
sustained_rps = 1
tokens_per_sec_peak = avg_tokens_per_req * peak_rps  # 3200
tokens_per_min = tokens_per_sec_peak * 60            # 192000
```
Rough infra suggestion: for peak interactive latency SLO (<300ms p50) -> 1xH100 (headroom) or 1xA100-80GB; cost-optimized path: quant-4 model on 1–2xA10G with aggressive batching and prefix caching.

cindy: Security checklist from FinTechX: SOC2 report, dedicated tenancy option (they prefer VPC/dedicated), KMS-managed keys, retention policy (default ask: 30 days), and explicit PII redaction before sending to hosted models. They will also want an NDA and data processing addendum.

sales_ops: Customer stated a POC budget target: ~$10k/mo but willing to cap the 2-week POC at $5k. Proposal idea: cap infra at $3.5k for the two weeks + $1k eng support + $500 contingency.

amal: If we quantize and enable batching/caching we can probably hit the $3.5k infra target. Action: I'll draft an SOW + minimal eval set. Need clear success criteria from product side. @sophie can you own the eval prompts?

matt: Agreed on quantization path. Notes:
- quant-4 + dynamic batching -> can run most workflows on 1xA10G at moderate loads
- long-sequence transcripts should route to H100 (or A100) instances to avoid OOM and high latency
- implement routing policy: short (<1024 tokens) -> quantized cheaper model, long -> high-memory node

deploy-bot: Canary deploy scheduled to staging cluster at 1998580000 for integration tests. :rocket:

cindy: Also confirm with customer whether they need logging of outputs for QA. If yes, require retention and access controls spelled out. Also they asked about penetration testing windows.

sophie: Proposed timeline:
- Week 0 (this week): integration + eval prompt collection
- Week 1: run evals, iterate prompts, baseline costs
- Week 2: ramp to peak, review success metrics
Success metrics suggestion: p95 latency <500ms, accuracy >85% on 5 targeted eval scenarios, overall POC infra cost <= $5k cap.

amal: Great — I'll send an updated SOW and cost breakdown by EOD. Next steps: @sophie create eval prompts, @matt create routing + infra playbook, @cindy collect security docs requested. Thanks :thumbsup:
